_note: What you see: Settings, MCP tools tab: this instance's MCP server with its address, outside agents with what they may call and on whose behalf, and the catalogue of all 42 tools with description, source app and risk.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Instellingen, tabblad MCP-tools: de MCP-server van deze instantie met adres, buitenagents met wat ze mogen aanroepen en namens wie, en de catalogus van alle 42 tools met beschrijving, bron-app en risico.
Een AI-agent buiten Nextcloud roept via: An AI agent outside Nextcloud calls this instance's tools through MCP. Every call goes through the same guidelines, risk classes and approvals as your own agent.
Uit betekent: geen enkele buitenagent ka: Off means: no outside agent can call anything any more.
Hoog risico blijft alleen voor eigen age: High risk stays with your own agents only, with approval.
Aanmelden met een app-wachtwoord van de: Sign in with an app password of the outside agent. Every call goes into the audit trail.
Leg vast welke buitenagent wat mag aanro: Record which outside agent may call what and on whose behalf. An outside agent never sees more than the account it acts for.

Elke tool die een agent kan gebruiken, m: Every tool an agent can use, with what it does and which app it comes from. Other apps register their tools themselves.
